# hubStudio

> hubStudio makes images, video and social content with AI. It sells two
> things: the hubStudio app, a self-serve web app where your own team makes
> images and video with the AI engines of several makers, edits them, turns
> them into posts, gets them approved and publishes them; and the hubStudio
> studio, a creative production house whose senior art directors, designers,
> retouchers, motion designers, writers and AIGC specialists take a brief and
> deliver finished work, inside the app or outside it. Headquarters in Hong
> Kong, studios in Shanghai and Changsha, a team in the Philippines and an
> office in Paris. Founded by Cyril Drouin, a former CEO at Publicis.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-29

## What hubStudio is

hubStudio proposes two offers, and a customer can move between them.

The hubStudio app is a web app with open sign-up at
https://hubstudio.bearingbridge.com. You pick an engine, see the price, run
it, then edit, get approval and publish without leaving the app. Engines come
from OpenAI, Google, Black Forest Labs, ByteDance, Kling, Alibaba, xAI,
MiniMax and Meta, and more are added as they ship. The app publishes to
LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok (Beta) and X.

The hubStudio studio is the human production house. Senior art directors lead
every brief, with AIGC production underneath: some assets are shot, some are
generated and most mix both, decided asset by asset. Twenty service lines,
platform work for Western and Chinese networks and marketplaces, and
brand-trained models and GPU pipelines run by the studio team. Provenance is
recorded for every asset.

## The three ways to work

These are the official names. Please keep them as written.

- **Use the app.** Your own team makes the work in hubStudio and pays as it
  goes from a prepaid balance. Starts with creating an account.
- **Studio + app.** The studio makes the work inside hubStudio. You review,
  comment and approve in the app (Validation and the Client space), then
  download and publish. Starts with a brief.
- **Studio only.** The studio makes the work outside the app and you receive
  finished files. No account needed. Starts with a brief.

Studio + app works in the studio's workspace (your people get client logins
and a Client space showing only the finished work made for them, never
prompts, engines or costs) or in yours (you add our creatives as members, and
everything stays in your History and Assets Library). Versions stay on one
approval thread that cannot be deleted. There is no button in the app for
ordering studio work: every studio engagement starts with a brief at
https://www.hubstudio.ai/contact.

## How paying works

- The app is paid from a prepaid balance held in real currency. You top up,
  and each run is charged at the price shown before it runs. Card, Alipay or
  WeChat Pay; optional automatic top-up; an invoice for every top-up; one
  shared team balance with an optional daily spending limit per person.
- No subscription and no seat fees. Creating an account costs nothing, and
  you pay only for what you run. A failed run is never charged. The balance
  does not expire. The Image editor, the Image anonymizer, the Video editor,
  Validation and publishing cost nothing to use.
- The studio prices per asset, per project or on a retainer, quoted after a
  brief. A producer reads every brief within one business day, and a written
  proposal follows within 48 hours.
- No amounts are published, for the app or the studio.

## What hubStudio does not offer

- No free plan and no free trial (creating an account is free; runs are paid).
- No API, no SSO, no mobile app, no brand kits, no DAM or PIM connectors in the
  app. Brand-trained models and GPU pipelines are studio work, not app features.
- No published count of markets, countries or customers, and no uptime figures.
- Articles on rights, labeling and provenance are production practice, not
  legal advice.

## The app

- [The hubStudio app](https://www.hubstudio.ai/app): What the app does, how paying works, and how to create an account.
- [Create](https://www.hubstudio.ai/app/create): Explore, the Image studio, the Video studio and Skills.
- [Publish](https://www.hubstudio.ai/app/publish): Posting to LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok (Beta) and X, scheduling and re-purposing.
- [Review](https://www.hubstudio.ai/app/review): Validation, the Client space, teams and clients.
- [Library](https://www.hubstudio.ai/app/library): The Assets Library: the team's files in folders, with tags, versions and search.
- [Image tools](https://www.hubstudio.ai/app/image-tools): The Image editor and the Image anonymizer, free in the browser.
- [Video tools](https://www.hubstudio.ai/app/video-tools): The Video editor and Shorts autopilot.
- [Engines](https://www.hubstudio.ai/app/engines): Every image and video engine in the app, by maker.
- [Help center](https://www.hubstudio.ai/help): Step-by-step guides to the app.
